title: Kidapawan Diocese mourns desecration of parish church

blocks.text: KIDAPAWAN CITY —The Diocese of Kidapawan has mourned the desecration of a parish church in M’lang town, after unidentified thieves robbed its tabernacle and dishonored the Blessed Sacrament. In a decree issued on Monday, Kidapawan Bishop Jose Colin Bagaforo directed the suspension of Masses and other sacramental celebrations at the Sta. Teresita del Niño Jesus Parish following the break-in incident on Oct. 25, where the consecrated hosts were taken out of the tabernacle and left on the sanctuary floor.
